title: Skip Dali's Paid Pagodas — the Old Town Is Free | China Travel Expert
description:
Hot take: in Dali, Yunnan, you can skip the ticketed Three Pagodas park and spend the day for free. Dali Old Town itself charges no entrance fee — all four of its old gates are open, and you can wander its lanes, courtyards and temple steps day or night without a ticket.

The famous Three Pagodas belong to Chongsheng Temple, a separate, ticketed park just outside the old-town walls. Worth a look — but the old town, where you actually walk, is the free part people forget to enjoy.

🧭 Expert Tip: Dali Old Town is free to enter at any hour — base yourself inside the walls, walk the temple steps and courtyards, and save the paid parks for one focused morning.
